summary: iter214 — Founding-50 Featured Clip incentive: verified backend + frontend. 7/7 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter214_clips_incentive.py: GET /api/clips/incentive-status shape ({slots_total:50, slots_used, slots_remaining, organic_clips_total, claimed}), public (no auth) 200, first organic POST /api/maker/clips returns featured=true with persisted row (is_seed:false), seeded rows (is_seed:true) excluded from organic+slots counts, padding to 50 organic featured then 51st URL-path upload returns featured=false (claimed:true), feed remains pure chronological created_at DESC, /clips/categories regression OK (6 cats). Frontend: /clips empty-state renders [data-testid=clips-incentive-banner] with copy 'MAKER INCENTIVE · 50 OF 50 FEATURED SLOTS LEFT' (variant=feed). Maker Dashboard → Settings → Workshop clips (feed) renders [data-testid=maker-clips-panel] + [data-testid=clips-incentive-banner] (variant=maker copy referencing /clips + 'Post a clip below to claim yours') above clips-mode-tabs. clips-incentive-banner-claimed branch not visible-tested because slots_used=0 in preview, but rendering paths share the same JSX block and were exercised by the 51st-upload backend test (claimed:true returned by API).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/clips.py: feed + get_clip still read `authorization` as a query param (carried over from iter210/211/213 reports). Frontend sends it as a header so i_liked/i_saved hydration only fires after the first toggle. One-line fix: `authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)`. NOT introduced by iter214 — pre-existing.

routers/clips.py: `_featured_clip_count()` is called twice in maker_create_clip and twice in maker_upload_clip on the hot path. Minor — at 50 cap the count is bounded. Could be a single read, but no correctness impact.

ClipFeedPage.jsx: the `clip-featured-<slug>` badge could not be visually verified because the live feed is empty. Backend returns featured:true correctly; JSX block is straightforward conditional render. Once any organic clip is posted, the badge will appear.
ClipsIncentiveBanner.jsx silently hides on API error (return null) — good UX choice for a soft feature.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner renders on both surfaces with correct variant copy + slot count)

seed_data_creation: Test inserts up to 50 synthetic {is_seed:false, featured:true} padding docs (id prefix TEST_pad_) + 1 seed doc (TEST_seed_) directly into Mongo, plus 2 real URL-path clips via /api/maker/clips. ALL test data deleted in try/finally + DELETE /api/maker/clips/{id}. Verified no residue.
